text:
Which statement is correct?
A
When anhydrous copper(II) sulfate is heated its colour changes to a deeper blue.
B
When hydrated copper(II) sulfate is heated its colour changes to a deeper blue.
When water is added to blue cobalt(II) chloride paper it turns pink.
C
When water is added to pink cobalt(II) chloride paper it turns blue.
D
